name: Hillsborough County, Florida (United States)
description: Upper half of pink and orange wave-like bands bearing a white ring with the county courthouse dome and EST 1834, over a navy blue lower half with the words Hillsborough County Florida in white and orange.
history: Hillsborough County is located in the west-central portion of Florida. The flag was adopted in 2016 (according to the Wikidata statement on the flag).

features.role: ring with the courthouse dome, EST 1834, and the county name
